# T10 evals — action-answering motion (spec §5b, ±5%)

Common: file `e2e/t10-motion.spec.ts`, line 1 `test.use({ channel: "chrome" });`. Mock server. Helper `anims(page)` = `page.evaluate(() => document.getAnimations().map(a => ({ name: a.animationName ?? a.transitionProperty, dur: a.effect.getTiming().duration, ease: a.effect.getTiming().easing, delay: a.effect.getTiming().delay, iter: a.effect.getTiming().iterations, state: a.playState, props: a.effect.getKeyframes().flatMap(k => Object.keys(k)).filter(k => !["offset","easing","composite","computedOffset"].includes(k)) })))`. Easing compare: parse the 4 numbers of `cubic-bezier(...)`, each within ±0.05 abs; duration within ±5%. Keyword easings (`linear`, `ease`, `ease-in-out`) compared as strings.

E1. Load quiet in app — test "no motion on load /home /policies /tools". For each route: goto, networkidle, wait 1500 ms, anims(page). PASS: every entry with state "running" has props only in {opacity, backgroundPosition}; zero running transform/translate/scale/filter/text-shadow animations on all three routes.

E2. Repeat nav no replay — test "nothing replays in session". Goto /home, sidebar to /policies, back to /home, read anims within 100 ms. PASS: zero running animations with transform/translate/scale props; no entry with duration 760 or 700.

E3. Emergency static — test "emergency has zero animations". Goto /emergency, wait 1500 ms. PASS: `document.getAnimations().length === 0`; hover and focus each `a`, re-read: still 0.

E4. Emergency links no transition — test "emergency links transition 0s". For every `a` and `button` on /emergency (count > 0): `getComputedStyle(el).transitionDuration` split on "," all === "0s" and `animationName` === "none". PASS: all match.

E5. Tab swaps Mercury — test "tools tab and signin filter swap use Mercury values". On /tools click a non-active role=tab; on /signin click a non-active filter chip; poll getAnimations within 50 ms after each click. PASS on both: entering content has translate/transform from `5px` to 0 plus opacity, duration 300 ±5% (285–315), easing `ease-in-out`; exiting content has opacity 1→0 and filter `blur(4px)`, duration 500 ±5% (475–525), easing `cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94)`. Verbatim spec: "in: translate 0 5px→0 + opacity, 300 ms ease-in-out; out: opacity 1→0 + blur(0→4px), 500 ms cubic-bezier(.25,.46,.45,.94)".

E6. Bars Copilot — test "coverage bars fill with Copilot values". Open a view with coverage bars (/home or /policies, after an action that shows them) and read anims. PASS: bar animation on transform scaleX 0→1, computed `transformOrigin` starts "0px"; duration 900 ±5% (855–945); easing `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`; paired opacity animation 900 ±5%, `cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1)`; next row delay is previous +120 ±5% (114–126 ms). Verbatim spec: "scaleX 0→1, origin left 900 ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) + opacity 900 ms (.25,1,.5,1); next row +120 ms".

E7. Rupee count-up — test "rupee figure counts up". Trigger an input change that alters a rupee figure; sample text at 0, 150, 450 ms and final. PASS: intermediate sample differs from both old and new value; final is the correct value; first tween settles in 900 ±5% (not before 855 ms, done by 945 ms); re-tween on input change settles ≤ 315 ms (300 ±5%); element computed `fontVariantNumeric` contains `tabular-nums`.

E8. Ask panel Wise/Monzo — test "ask panel dimmer and panel values". Click Ask FAB, read anims. PASS: dimmer opacity 350 ±5% (332–368 ms), easing `cubic-bezier(0.8, 0.05, 0.2, 0.95)`; panel translateX(16px) (desktop) or translateY(14px) (390 px viewport) plus opacity, 300 ±5% (285–315 ms). Verbatim spec: "dimmer opacity 350 ms cubic-bezier(.8,.05,.2,.95); panel translateX(16px)/translateY(14px) + opacity 300 ms".

E9. Public entrance — test "landing headline and reveals". Goto /, read anims at load, scroll a section into view, read again; goto /signin. PASS: / headline per-word text-shadow + opacity, 1500 ±5% (1425–1575), easing `ease`, word i delay = i*100 ±5%; scroll reveal translateY(40px) + opacity from 0.1, 700 ±5% (665–735), `cubic-bezier(0.37, 0.34, 0.26, 0.9)`, siblings +75 ±5%; /signin headline 1020 ±5% (969–1071), `cubic-bezier(0.22, 0.61, 0.36, 1)`, +90 ms per word; /home greeting has zero animations. Verbatim spec: "text-shadow 30px→0 + opacity, 1500 ms ease, +100 ms per word"; "translateY(40px) + opacity .1→1, 700 ms cubic-bezier(.37,.34,.26,.9); siblings +75 ms"; "Slice word values (1020 ms (.22,.61,.36,1), +90 ms/word)".

E10. Marquee — test "signin lanes marquee 48s and pause off-screen". On /signin read lane animation. PASS: duration 48000 ±5% (45600–50400), easing `linear`, iterations Infinity (second lane, if present, 56000 ±5%); scroll lanes off-screen, wait 300 ms: playState "paused"; scroll back: "running". Spec: "marquee 48 s linear infinite, pause on hover and off-screen".

E11. Reduced motion — test "reduced motion stops transforms". `page.emulateMedia({ reducedMotion: "reduce" })`, goto /tools, click another tab, wait 50 ms. PASS: no running animation with props including transform/translate/scale/rotate. Repeat with in-app Reduce motion setting on (OS media not emulated): same PASS. /signin lanes under reduce: no running transform animation.

E12. Static greps — `grep -rnE 'transition:\s*all' src | wc -l` PASS if prints 0. `grep -n 'reducedMotion="user"' src/app/layout.tsx` PASS if 1 hit. `grep -rn 'reducedMotion="always"' src` PASS if >=1 hit on emergency route. `grep -nE '(animation|transition):\s*none\s*!important' src/app/\(app\)/emergency/emergency.css` PASS if both animation and transition lines found.

E13. verify — `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build` — PASS if exit 0.
